source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 978 replaces the special URI path for an unselected row with selection of that row before getURIsForSelection. Current drag handling retains this order. The view can then expand a collapsed thread into all of its message URIs. Current tests check both the new visible selection and the three source messages in an unselected collapsed thread. Existing selected multi-message drags retain their selection. This is the thread-pane drag contract, not a rule that every pointer action selects a row.
title: Select the drag source before collecting selected message URIs
